newsitem.title: USA: Fedders to redeem convertible prfrd shares.
newsitem.headline: Fedders to redeem convertible prfrd shares.

text.p: Fedders Corp said on Tuesday it will redeem its convertible preferred stock on September 19, 1997 for shares of its class A stock.
Each share of preferred stock will be redeemed for 1.022 shares of Class A Stock based on the average closing price of $6.113 of the class A stock for the 10 trading days ended August 18, 1997.
Fractional shares and all share accounts holding 100 shares or less of the convertible preferred stock will be paid in cash at the rate of $6.25 per share, Fedders said in a statement.
No further dividend is payable on the convertible preferred stock subsequent to the final dividend paid on July 1, 1997.
